snippet.title: SECT0R: Cyber Crash - Official Opening Movie
snippet.description:
====================================
Omniverse Staff Team
@External_VR: Owner of Omniverse

Arzue aka Gemforcegold06: 
Co owner of Omniverse/Beta tester
===================================
From SECT0R: Team we give you a SECT0R Game
Inspired off of Persona and Trails of Cold Steal. 
Follow Genesis and her friends in a new journey 
following her father's (The Omen) Footsteps.
In the Small town of Ironwood. 

Opening Movie Music: The Reflection by Void Chords
===================================
Intro Music: Sage 2023
===================================
